title: Eight Sleep Bed Exit Count
app: Apple Health / Apple Watch exports, Oura, WHOOP, Dexcom, Levels, LibreView, Eight Sleep, Withings, and Garmin Body Battery feeds via vendor APIs, exports, Home Assistant bridges, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=eightsleep:sleep
| bin _time span=1d
| stats max(bed_exit_count) as bed_exit_count by sleeper _time
| where bed_exit_count>3
| sort - bed_exit_count
description: Uses Eight Sleep sleep summaries telemetry to monitor how often the bed session was interrupted in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for restless nights with repeated bed exits, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Eight Sleep sleep summaries data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Daily chart of bed exits per sleeper.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors how often the bed session was interrupted so you can spot restless nights with repeated bed exits before it becomes annoying.
